solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Nearest one gets to star for each current male celebrity

parts.note: per means for each, as in 'per head'
I is the physics symbol for electric current
he is the male pronoun
a lion is a celebrated person, as in 'literary lion'

explanation.surface: A tour of who stands closest to a star: the current male celebrity of the moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'star' reads as a famous person beside 'celebrity', but the definition is astronomical.
explanation.definitionFit: Perihelion is the point in an orbit closest to the sun, our own star.

clue.text: Plan installing current circuit broken by minute indicator

indicators.note: the plan installs the current, taking its letter inside

parts.note: a plot is a plan
I is the physics symbol for current

indicators.note: the lap is broken open and the minute's letter set into it

parts.note: a lap is one circuit of a track

explanation.surface: An electrical plan in which a broken circuit is shown by a tiny indicator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'installing' puts I into PLOT; 'broken by' puts M into LAP.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot lamp is a small light showing that a device is switched on, so it acts as an indicator.

clue.text: Member of rose family Rosa, but it's become pale and sickly

indicators.note: the letters for sex appeal become something else, so they are replaced

parts.note: taken as the name Rosa
it is a slang word for sex appeal, SA, and the 's ties it to what follows
wan means pale and sickly-looking

explanation.surface: Poor Rosa has lost her bloom and turned pale and sickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' is crossword shorthand for sex appeal, SA. 'become' replaces the SA of ROSA with WAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The rowan, or mountain ash, belongs to the Rosaceae, the rose family of plants.

clue.text: Exploit holiday island in part of Hong Kong for criminal activity

indicators.note: in places these letters inside the part of the place name

parts.note: Hong is one of the two words of the place name
to use is to exploit
a break is a holiday

explanation.surface: Taking advantage of an island holiday in Hong Kong to commit crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'part of Hong Kong' is just one word of the name, not a district; 'in' is the insertion signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Housebreaking is the crime of breaking into a building to steal, a form of burglary.

clue.text: A title abandoned outside of university in old Paris

indicators.note: the rearranged letters sit outside the university letter, enclosing it
abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so these letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone gave up a title, quitting university life in old Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abandoned' rearranges A TITLE; 'outside of' puts that around U.
explanation.definitionFit: Lutetia was the Roman name of the settlement that became Paris.

clue.text: Turkish chap covered in exotic oils

indicators.note: the chap is covered by the rearranged letters, sitting inside them
exotic means strange and outlandish, so these letters take on an unusual order

parts.note: a man is a chap

explanation.surface: A Turkish man smothered in exotic oils at the bathhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exotic' gives OSLI and 'covered in' puts the chap inside it. Osmanli comes from Osman, founder of the Ottoman dynasty.
explanation.definitionFit: Osmanli is an old word for Ottoman, so it describes the Turks of the Ottoman empire.

clue.text: Group of fighters is clear when uncovered

indicators.note: uncovering strips off the outer covering, so the word for clear loses its first and last letters

parts.note: limpid means clear, as of water

explanation.surface: A group of fighters is in the clear once its cover is blown.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when uncovered' removes L and D, the outer letters of LIMPID. An impi is a Zulu regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: An impi was a regiment or armed band of Zulu warriors.

clue.text: Mass troubles to Tyneside perhaps can be a burden

parts.note: M is the symbol for mass
ills are troubles
Tyneside is in the North East of England, NE

explanation.surface: Huge troubles for Tyneside can weigh it down.
explanation.walkthrough: Tyneside is the area around Newcastle in North East England.
explanation.definitionFit: A millstone round your neck is a heavy burden, from the great stones used to grind grain.

clue.text: Vegan eats this up to make vegetarian angry

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the letters are read from bottom to top
the word vegan swallows the answer's letters to make a longer word, so they are found inside it

explanation.surface: A vegan eats this up and it makes a vegetarian angry.
explanation.walkthrough: VEG and AN wrapped round ETARI make VEGETARIAN; 'up' says ETARI is the answer read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Irate is a plain synonym of angry, meaning furious.

clue.text: Left a wife with set of clothes in case

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for wife, as in genealogies
a suit is a matching set of clothes

explanation.surface: A man left his wife with a suit of clothes packed in a suitcase.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case' looks like luggage after the clothes, but it is a court case.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawsuit is a case brought before a civil court.

clue.text: Carpet laid badly for follower of waltzing?

parts.note: a mat is a small carpet

indicators.note: laid badly means the letters of laid are put down wrongly, rearranged

explanation.surface: A carpet laid badly is the thing that trips up a waltzing dancer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badly' rearranges LAID to ILDA. 'Waltzing Matilda' is Australia's best-known folk song.
explanation.definitionFit: In the song title 'Waltzing Matilda' the word Matilda comes straight after waltzing.

clue.text: Operetta tune "Romeo, Romeo", unknown text overleaf?

parts.note: a theme is a tune
Romeo is R in the NATO alphabet
the second Romeo is another R
Y is an algebraic unknown
a widow is a printer's term for the last line of a paragraph carried over to the next page

explanation.surface: A tune titled 'Romeo, Romeo' from an operetta, with unknown words over the page.
explanation.walkthrough: In printing, a widow is a stray end-of-paragraph line left alone at the top of a page.
explanation.definitionFit: The Merry Widow is Franz Lehár's famous operetta of 1905.

clue.text: A suggestion can get detailed

parts.note: a tin is a can

indicators.note: read as de-tailed: the word get loses its tail, its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone hints that a can could be made more detailed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'detailed' is read as de-tailed, cutting the T off GET to leave GE.
explanation.definitionFit: A tinge is a slight trace or hint, a suggestion of something such as a colour.

clue.text: State game needs energy for one to learn

indicators.note: energy for one means E stands in place of the letter for one

parts.note: tennis is a game
I is the Roman numeral one
E is the symbol for energy
to see is to learn or understand, as in 'I see'

explanation.surface: A US state's game needs energy if anyone is to learn it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' swaps the I in TENNIS for E, giving TENNES.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennessee is one of the states of the USA.

clue.text: Choosing system to change local time in Orkney bay

parts.note: to alter is to change
a native is a local person

indicators.note: time in the bay means the letter for time sits inside the word for the bay

parts.note: a voe is a bay or inlet in Orkney and Shetland

explanation.surface: Some campaign proposes changing local time across an Orkney bay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts T inside VOE, giving VOTE. Orkney is a group of Scottish islands, where a voe is an inlet.
explanation.definitionFit: The alternative vote is an electoral method in which voters rank candidates in order of preference.

clue.text: Of the sea, it's mostly stupid putting a girl in

indicators.note: putting in places the letters inside the shortened word
mostly means most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: thick means stupid
a lass is a girl

explanation.surface: Something about the sea, said to be mostly stupid for including a girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the last letter, leaving THIC; 'putting ... in' is the insertion signal. 'Of the sea' is a definition by phrase, matching an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Thalassic is a learned adjective meaning relating to seas, from the Greek thalassa.

clue.text: Really how it appears for idealist?

definitions.meaning: really here is an intensifier meaning very
in the word idealist, the letters I and T stand at the two ends, so the word it shows up at its outer limits

explanation.surface: Asking how reality looks to a dreamer.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is cryptic: the first and last letters of IDEALIST spell 'it', so 'it' appears at the extremes of that word.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are intensifying adverbs meaning very, as in 'really hot'; the second sense describes letters sitting at the outer limits.

clue.text: Firework pops with rather ashen swirling

indicators.note: swirling stirs these letters round into a new order

explanation.surface: A firework goes off with pops, swirling smoke rather like ash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swirling' rearranges POPS plus RATHER ASHEN together.
explanation.definitionFit: Pharaoh's serpent is a chemical novelty firework that grows a long ashy snake when lit.

clue.text: Rather warm house, always dry one, shut up

parts.note: TT, teetotal, describes someone who never drinks alcohol
I is the Roman numeral one
sh is a call to be quiet

explanation.surface: A rather warm house, always dry, with one room shut up.
explanation.walkthrough: TT stands for teetotal, a person who never drinks alcohol.
explanation.definitionFit: Hottish means fairly hot, slightly more than lukewarm.

clue.text: Come after County Council, note, prosecuted for housing

indicators.note: the word for prosecuted houses the other letters inside it

parts.note: sued means took legal action against
CC is the abbreviation for County Council
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A County Council taken to court over its housing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'housing' looks like council homes in the surface, but it is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To succeed someone is to follow them in a role, coming after them.

clue.text: Reverting to older form of Greek without classical name for bird

indicators.note: without means outside here: the Greek word goes round the Latin bird

parts.note: Attic is the Greek of ancient Athens
avis is Latin for bird

explanation.surface: Reverting to an older form of Greek, minus the classical name of a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here, not lacking. Attic Greek was the dialect of ancient Athens.
explanation.definitionFit: Atavistic describes traits that throw back to a remote ancestor, a reversion to an earlier type.

clue.text: Collect is a church form of worship

parts.note: the Mass is the central service of worship in the Catholic church

explanation.surface: A collect is a short prayer, part of a church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Collect' looks like the noun for a short prayer, which fits the church surface, but it is the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To amass is to gather or accumulate, the verb sense of collect.

clue.text: We must cross a street for litter

indicators.note: the word we stretches across the other letters, so they sit inside it

explanation.surface: We must cross a street to pick up litter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'must cross' has WE straddle A and ST.
explanation.definitionFit: Waste is rubbish, the same sense as litter dropped in the street.

clue.text: Stop running market booth

definitions.meaning: an engine that stops running suddenly cuts out
a stand or ... selling goods at a market

explanation.surface: A market trader shutting up shop.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine stalls when it cuts out, and a stall is a trader's stand at a market.

clue.text: Simple weapon like one a long time back

parts.note: as means like

indicators.note: back means these letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
ages means a long time

explanation.surface: A primitive weapon, like one used a long time ago.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns I plus AGES into SEGAI.
explanation.definitionFit: An assegai is a light spear, a basic weapon used by peoples of southern Africa.

clue.text: When a king could be under pressure to kill pheasants, perhaps

definitions.text: When a king could be under pressure

parts.note: to end something is to kill it
pheasants are an example of game birds

explanation.surface: A king's shoot, with the pressure on to bag pheasants.
explanation.walkthrough: The king is a chess piece, not a royal at a shoot.
explanation.definitionFit: The endgame is the last stage of a chess match, when the king is often under attack.

clue.text: Rifle fire

definitions.meaning: to rifle is to plunder or ransack
to fire someone is to dismiss them from a job

explanation.surface: Rifle fire.
explanation.definitionFit: To sack a town is to loot it, and to sack an employee is to dismiss them.

clue.text: Projected drama featured tortured POW in murder

indicators.note: in places the earlier letters inside the word for murder

parts.note: to slay is to murder
had means featured, as in 'the show had a famous star'

indicators.note: tortured means twisted, so these letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: A drama featuring a tortured prisoner of war caught up in a murder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tortured' gives OWP; 'in' is the insertion signal. 'Projected' points to images thrown onto a screen.
explanation.definitionFit: Shadow play is theatre in which the figures are seen as shadows thrown onto a screen.
